Container.Name: lancache-manager
Container.Overview: LANCache Manager - web UI for monitoring and managing a LANCache server. Prefill Steam, Epic, Battle.net, Riot, and Xbox; process logs; clear and scan the cache; check DNS and cache health.
Container.Description: LANCache Manager provides a web dashboard for monitoring and managing your LANCache. Includes embedded PostgreSQL, real-time SignalR updates, Scheduled Prefill for Steam/Epic/Battle.net/Riot/Xbox, Status Check, corruption detection, cache management, and Prometheus metrics. Docs: https://regix1.github.io/lancache-manager/

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the LANCache Manager web interface.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Required: database, PostgreSQL data, API key, themes, prefill state, and cached images.

Config.Name: LANCache Logs
Config.Description: Required: path to your LANCache log directory. Keep read-only for monitoring-only. Switch to read/write to allow log removal/rewrites.

Config.Name: LANCache Cache
Config.Description: Required: path to your LANCache cache directory. Keep read-only for monitoring-only. Switch to read/write to enable cache clearing, corruption removal, and game removal.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Optional but recommended: Docker socket for nginx log reopen and spawning Steam/Epic/Battle.net/Riot/Xbox prefill containers.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for log timestamps and display. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

Config.Name: LANCache Log Path
Config.Description: Path to the LANCache access log inside the container. For a bare-metal per-service log folder mounted at /logs, use /logs (or /logs/http if that is what you mounted).

Config.Name: LANCache Cache Path
Config.Description: Path to the LANCache cache directory inside the container. Must point at the directory that directly contains the hash folders (00, 1a, ... ff).

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Mode
Config.Description: embedded (default): PostgreSQL runs inside this container. external: connect to a Postgres you run yourself.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Username
Config.Description: PostgreSQL username.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Password
Config.Description: PostgreSQL password. If unset in embedded mode, a first-run setup page collects credentials. Once set via the UI, they persist in /data.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Host
Config.Description: External mode only: hostname or IP of your PostgreSQL server. Ignored when POSTGRES_MODE=embedded.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Port
Config.Description: External mode only: PostgreSQL port.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Database
Config.Description: PostgreSQL database name.

Config.Name: Enable Authentication
Config.Description: Master switch for authentication. true = require API key for admin features (recommended). false = disable all authentication (development only).

Config.Name: Guest Session Duration (Hours)
Config.Description: Default guest session duration in hours (also configurable in the UI).

Config.Name: Require Auth for Metrics
Config.Description: Require API key for the Prometheus /metrics endpoint. false = /metrics is publicly accessible.

Config.Name: Allowed CORS Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins. Empty allows all. Example: http://localhost:3000,https://mysite.com

Config.Name: Known Proxy Networks
Config.Description: Comma-separated CIDR list of trusted reverse proxies for X-Forwarded-For (e.g. 172.16.0.0/12,10.0.0.0/8). Set this when nginx or Traefik fronts the manager so client IPs are correct. Loopback is always trusted.

Config.Name: Trust All Proxies
Config.Description: Trust every upstream proxy unconditionally. Convenient for local dev. Never enable on an internet-exposed host.

Config.Name: Force Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Force the Secure flag on the session cookie even when the request is not detected as HTTPS. Enable behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Nginx Log Rotation Enabled
Config.Description: Signal nginx to reopen logs after the app rewrites them. Containerized nginx needs the Docker socket. Host-run nginx needs Extra Parameters: --pid=host (CAP_KILL is available by default).

Config.Name: Nginx Container Name
Config.Description: LANCache container name for log rotation. auto = find containers with lancache in the name.

Config.Name: Nginx Rotation Schedule (Hours)
Config.Description: How often to check whether log rotation is needed, in hours.

Config.Name: Prefill Cache Server IP
Config.Description: Recommended: IP of your LANCache HTTP server (port 80). Prefill then talks to the cache by IP. Strongly recommended for Battle.net and any non-standard DNS setup.

Config.Name: Prefill Network Mode
Config.Description: Docker network mode for prefill containers: host, bridge, a Docker network name, or auto.

Config.Name: Prefill DNS IP
Config.Description: IP of your lancache-dns (or AdGuard/Pi-hole). Used in bridge mode. auto reuses the detected lancache-dns container IP.

Config.Name: Steam Prefill Docker Image
Config.Description: Docker image for Steam prefill containers.

Config.Name: Epic Prefill Docker Image
Config.Description: Docker image for Epic prefill containers.

Config.Name: Battle.net Prefill Docker Image
Config.Description: Docker image for Battle.net prefill containers.

Config.Name: Riot Prefill Docker Image
Config.Description: Docker image for Riot prefill containers.

Config.Name: Xbox Prefill Docker Image
Config.Description: Docker image for Xbox prefill containers.

Config.Name: Prefill Session Timeout (Minutes)
Config.Description: Lifetime of a non-persistent admin prefill session, in minutes.

Config.Name: Prefill Stall Timeout (Seconds)
Config.Description: Advanced: no-progress time before a non-persistent session counts as stalled. Scheduled Prefill uses its own 30-minute cutoff.

Config.Name: Prefill Daemon Base Path
Config.Description: Container path where prefill session state is stored. Must stay under /data for sibling-container access.

Config.Name: Prefill Host Data Path
Config.Description: Host path that maps to this container's /data volume. Auto-detected from mounts; set only if detection fails.

Config.Name: Prefill Use TCP
Config.Description: Communicate with prefill daemons over TCP instead of a Unix socket. auto = true on Windows, false on Linux. Linux users only need this to force TCP.

Config.Name: Prefill TCP Port
Config.Description: TCP port the daemon listens on inside its container. TCP mode only.

Config.Name: Prefill Host TCP Port
Config.Description: TCP port published on the host for prefill containers. Empty = random free port. TCP mode only.

Config.Name: Prefill TCP Host
Config.Description: Host the daemon binds to and the manager connects to over TCP. TCP mode only.

Config.Name: LANCache Env File Path
Config.Description: Path to the lancache .env file for reading CACHE_DISK_SIZE when the Docker socket is unavailable. Leave blank to auto-search common locations.

Config.Name: Auto Discover Datasources
Config.Description: Auto-detect datasources by scanning /cache and /logs for matching subdirectories, up to three levels deep.

Config.Name: Max Clients Per Request
Config.Description: Max number of clients returned in a single stats request.

Config.Name: Default Clients Limit
Config.Description: Default client limit when none is provided.

Config.Name: Enable GC Management
Config.Description: Show memory management controls in Management. Useful on low-memory systems.

Config.Name: ASP.NET Core URLs
Config.Description: Internal port binding. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
